title: PRESIDENT’S GREETINGS ON THE EVE OF PARSI NEW YEAR
body_text:
The President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu in her message on the eve of the Parsi New Year says: -
“On the auspicious occasion of Parsi New Year Navroz, I extend my warm greetings and best wishes to all fellow citizens living in India and abroad, especially Parsi brothers and sisters.
Navroz symbolises new beginnings and renewed hope. This festival of joy and harmony reminds us of the values of co-existence and service to humanity. The Parsi community has made significant contributions to India's development through its spirit of enterprise and philanthropy.
I am confident that this sacred festival will inspire all citizens to work together towards building an inclusive and developed India. May this festival bring happiness, peace and prosperity to all”.

enrichment.summary: President Droupadi Murmu issued a greetings message on the eve of Navroz (Parsi New Year), extending wishes to citizens in India and abroad, especially the Parsi community. She highlighted the community's contributions to India's development through enterprise and philanthropy, and expressed hope that the festival inspires unity towards an inclusive, developed India.
enrichment.context: This is a routine ceremonial greeting issued annually by the President's Secretariat on the occasion of Navroz, marking the Parsi/Zoroastrian New Year. Such messages are customary goodwill gestures extended on major festivals of India's diverse religious communities and carry no policy content. The Parsi community, though numerically small, is often noted for its historical role in Indian industry, philanthropy, and nation-building (e.g., Tata, Godrej, Wadia families), which the message alludes to in general terms.
